d: We are seeking a motivated, creative, and detail-oriented Junior Angular Developer – Remote to join our remote development team. This entry-level position focuses on building, updating, and maintaining responsive websites and user interfaces while supporting front-end development projects.
The ideal candidate has a basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, enjoys solving technical problems, and is eager to improve their web development skills in a collaborative environment.

Previous professional development experience is not required. Training, mentorship, and ongoing guidance will be provided. Recent graduates, coding bootcamp participants, self-taught developers, career changers, and candidates seeking their first professional development role are encouraged to apply.
Build and maintain web pages using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Assist with developing responsive and user-friendly interfaces.
Translate approved designs and mockups into functional web pages.
Update existing website layouts, styles, and components.
Implement basic interactive features and page functionality.
Follow established coding standards and development guidelines.
Support ongoing website improvements and maintenance.
Assist with creating clean, consistent, and accessible interfaces.
Implement reusable interface elements and components.
Maintain consistent styling across pages and applications.
Help improve website navigation and usability.
Support responsive layouts for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Follow approved design systems and interface guidelines.
Collaborate with designers to implement visual updates.
Test web pages across common browsers and devices.
Identify and troubleshoot basic layout and functionality issues.
Fix simple HTML, CSS, and JavaScript errors.
Review pages for responsiveness and usability.
Escalate complex technical issues when necessary.
Update and maintain existing front-end code.
Organize project files and development resources.
Follow established naming conventions and coding practices.
Assist with code reviews and suggested improvements.
Use version-control tools according to team procedures.
Help keep front-end components consistent and maintainable.
Complete assigned development tasks within established timelines.
Communicate blockers or technical challenges promptly.
Participate in project discussions and planning sessions.
Support small feature updates and website improvements.
Work with senior developers to understand project requirements.
Communicate professionally through email, chat, and virtual meetings.
Collaborate with developers, designers, and project coordinators.
Participate in virtual standups, code reviews, and training sessions.
Ask questions and request clarification when needed.
Share progress updates on assigned tasks.
Maintain dependable communication during scheduled working hours.
q: High school diploma, GED, or equivalent; relevant coursework or technical training is welcome.
Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Familiarity with responsive web design concepts.
Basic knowledge of website structure and browser functionality.
Ability to read, understand, and modify simple front-end code.
Willingness to learn new frameworks, tools, and technologies.
Ability to follow technical instructions and coding guidelines.
Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
Reliable internet connection and suitable remote workspace.
Professional development experience is not required. Familiarity with any of the following may be helpful:
CSS frameworks such as Bootstrap or Tailwind CSS.
Personal projects, coding bootcamp assignments, academic projects, open-source contributions, freelance work, or a GitHub portfolio may be considered relevant demonstrations of skills.
Depending on employment status, location, and eligibility, benefits may include:
Paid time off and company holidays.
Health, dental, and vision benefits where applicable.
Exposure to modern web development tools.
You may be a strong fit if you enjoy building websites, experimenting with user interfaces, learning new technologies, and solving technical challenges.
You are curious, dependable, detail-oriented, and motivated to grow your development skills while collaborating with a remote team.
This position can provide a foundation for a career in front-end development, web development, user interface engineering, or software development.
Interested candidates should submit an updated resume and complete the required application information.
Applicants are encouraged to include links to personal websites, GitHub profiles, portfolios, or relevant development projects when available.
Qualified candidates may be invited to a virtual interview and a brief technical assessment covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript fundamentals, responsive design, or basic debugging.
Selected candidates will receive additional information regarding onboarding, technical training, scheduling, equipment requirements, and anticipated start date.

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and maintaining a respectful and inclusive workplace. Qualified applicants will be considered based on their skills, qualifications, and ability to perform the responsibilities of the position without discrimination based on characteristics protected by applicable law.
